idea-plugin.name: Revision Graph
idea-plugin.description:
An interactive, native IntelliJ revision graph backed by Git.

Explore branches, tags, merges, and repository topology; compare or check out revisions; and open focused Git Log views using the IDE's bundled Git integration.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
2.0.0

  • Trace dual-revision fork paths using their matching selection colors.
  • Inspect upstream divergence and create branches or tags through native Git4Idea workflows.
  • Control visible reference categories without changing the loaded repository topology.
  • Fetch project remotes through IntelliJ's registered Git4Idea action.
